Apache HTTP Server:2.4.49.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal & Remote Code Execution
Apache HTTP Server:2.4.49.description: Flaw in path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 enables unauthenticated remote attackers to map URLs to files outside the expected document root and execute arbitrary code via CGI scripts.
Apache HTTP Server:2.4.49.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later. Disable mod_cgi if not required.

Apache HTTP Server:2.4.50.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal & RCE (Incomplete Fix)
Apache HTTP Server:2.4.50.description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 allows attackers to exploit path traversal to execute arbitrary code or view sensitive configuration files.
Apache HTTP Server:2.4.50.remediation: Update to Apache HTTP Server 2.4.51 or newer.

Apache Log4j:2.14.1.title: Apache Log4j JNDI Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Apache Log4j:2.14.1.description: JNDI lookup feature in Log4j allows unauthenticated remote code execution when user-controlled strings are logged via LDAP or RMI endpoints.
Apache Log4j:2.14.1.remediation: Update log4j-core to 2.17.1 or higher. Set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true as emergency mitigation.

Spring Framework:5.3.17.title: Spring Framework Remote Code Execution (Spring4Shell)
Spring Framework:5.3.17.description: Class loader manipulation via parameter binding allows attackers to write JSP web shells to webroot when running on Tomcat as a WAR deployment.
Spring Framework:5.3.17.remediation: Upgrade Spring Framework to 5.3.18+ or 5.2.20+. Enforce custom WebDataBinder disallowFields.

OpenSSH:7.2p2.title: OpenSSH User Enumeration Timing Attack
OpenSSH:7.2p2.description: Timing discrepancy in SSH authentication allows unauthenticated remote attackers to determine valid system usernames.
OpenSSH:7.2p2.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to version 7.3 or above.

OpenSSH:7.2p2.title: OpenSSH Untrusted Search Path Remote Code Execution
OpenSSH:7.2p2.description: Vulnerability in ssh-agent forwarding allows loading of arbitrary PKCS#11 modules leading to command execution.
OpenSSH:7.2p2.remediation: Disable ssh-agent forwarding or update OpenSSH.

OpenSSH:8.2p1.title: OpenSSH PKCS#11 Provider Remote Code Execution
OpenSSH:8.2p1.description: Flaw in ssh-agent's PKCS#11 provider allows arbitrary shared library loading and remote execution via forwarded agent sockets.

Citrix Gateway:13.1.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC / Gateway Sensitive Memory Leak (Citrix Bleed)
Citrix Gateway:13.1.description: Buffer overflow in OpenID Connect endpoint dumps active session tokens, allowing attackers to bypass multi-factor authentication.
Citrix Gateway:13.1.remediation: Apply vendor security patch immediately and terminate all active session cookies.

Active Directory Netlogon:2019.title: Microsoft Netlogon Elevation of Privilege (Zerologon)
Active Directory Netlogon:2019.description: Cryptographic flaw in AES-CFB8 implementation allows unauthenticated attackers to set the domain controller password to blank.
Active Directory Netlogon:2019.remediation: Install Microsoft Patch KB4565349 and enforce secure RPC communications.

PostgreSQL:12.0.title: PostgreSQL Type Confusion Arbitrary Memory Disclosure
PostgreSQL:12.0.description: Type confusion when handling custom user-defined type conversions can trigger server crashes or leak backend memory contents.
PostgreSQL:12.0.remediation: Upgrade PostgreSQL to version 12.1 or newer.

Redis:6.0.title: Redis Debian/Ubuntu Package Lua Sandbox Escape RCE
Redis:6.0.description: Improper initialization of Lua library in packaged Redis instances allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via Lua scripts.
Redis:6.0.remediation: Upgrade redis-server debian package and require strong authentication passwords.

Microsoft Outlook / Windows:2021.title: Microsoft Outlook Moniker Remote Code Execution
Microsoft Outlook / Windows:2021.description: Bypasses Protected View checks via crafted 'file://' monikers, sending NTLM hashes or executing untrusted code with user privileges.
Microsoft Outlook / Windows:2021.remediation: Apply Microsoft February 2024 Patch Tuesday updates.

Palo Alto PAN-OS:10.2.title: Palo Alto PAN-OS GlobalProtect Command Injection
Palo Alto PAN-OS:10.2.description: Command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect feature of PAN-OS software allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
